description: Structured eval definitions for the CodeArtifact Repository Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across package formats (npm, pip, maven, swift) and scenarios (single-account, multi-hop upstreams, cross-account RAM sharing) plus a prerequisite failure branch (missing parent domain). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: npm repository with public:npmjs external connection and internal upstream
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — npm repo, external connection + internal upstream, IAM policies
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a CodeArtifact npm repository named shared-npm in us-east-1. Domain: shared (existing, owner 123456789012). Associate the public:npmjs external connection. Chain upstream to shared-internal (an internal npm mirror repository that already exists in the same domain). Repository consume access for the ci-build IAM role. Repository publish access for the release-pipeline IAM role. CI builds use the codeartifact login CLI for npm. Tags: Environment=production, Format=npm. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
REPOSITORY: shared-npm
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Domain — shared (existing, owner 123456789012)
  [✓]      Repository — shared-npm
  [✓]      Format — npm
  [✓]      Upstream chain — shared-internal -> external:npmjs
  [✓]      External connection — public:npmjs (CodeArtifact managed)
  [✓]      Connection — arn:aws:codeartifact:us-east-1:123456789012:repository/shared/shared-npm
  [✓]      Domain owner IAM — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/devops-admin (codeartifact:* on domain)
  [✓]      Repository consume policy — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-build (ReadFromRepository, GetAuthorizationToken, GetPackageVersionAsset)
  [✓]      Repository publish policy — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/release-pipeline (PublishPackageVersion, PutPackageMetadata)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws codeartifact describe-domain --domain shared --domain-owner 123456789012
  aws codeartifact describe-repository --domain shared --repository shared-npm
  aws codeartifact list-repositories-in-domain --domain shared
  aws codeartifact list-external-connections --domain shared
  aws codeartifact get-repository-endpoint --domain shared --repository shared-npm --format npm
  aws codeartifact login --tool npm --repository shared-npm --domain shared --domain-owner 123456789012

eval_cases.name: Parent domain does not exist — deployment blocker
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a CodeArtifact pip repository named payments-pip in us-east-1. Domain: payments-team (does NOT exist in the account; describe-domain returns ResourceNotFoundException). Associate public:pypi external connection. CI role: payments-ci. Release role: payments-release. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
REPOSITORY: payments-pip
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗]      Domain — MISSING. The parent domain payments-team does not exist in account 123456789012. A CodeArtifact repository cannot exist without a parent domain. Create the domain first via `aws codeartifact create-domain --domain payments-team` or reference an existing domain.
  [✓]      Repository — payments-pip (pending parent domain)
  [✓]      Format — pip
  [INPUT NEEDED] External connection — public:pypi (depends on domain)
  [INPUT NEEDED] Upstream chain — depends on domain
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws codeartifact describe-domain --domain payments-team
  aws codeartifact create-domain --domain payments-team

eval_cases.name: maven repository with multi-hop upstream chain
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — maven multi-hop upstreams + external connection
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a CodeArtifact maven repository named team-payments-maven in us-east-1. Domain: shared (existing, owner 123456789012). Multi-hop upstream chain: team-payments-internal, then shared-maven (both already exist in the domain), then the public:maven-central external connection on shared-maven. CI role: payments-ci with ReadFromRepository and GetAuthorizationToken. Release role: payments-release with PublishPackageVersion. CI uses the codeartifact login CLI for mvn. Tags: Environment=production, Team=payments, Format=maven. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
REPOSITORY: team-payments-maven
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Domain — shared (existing, owner 123456789012)
  [✓]      Repository — team-payments-maven
  [✓]      Format — maven
  [✓]      Upstream chain — team-payments-internal -> shared-maven -> external:maven-central
  [✓]      External connection — public:maven-central (on shared-maven)
  [✓]      Connection — arn:aws:codeartifact:us-east-1:123456789012:repository/shared/team-payments-maven
  [✓]      Domain owner IAM — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/devops-admin
  [✓]      Repository consume policy — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/payments-ci (ReadFromRepository, GetAuthorizationToken)
  [✓]      Repository publish policy — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/payments-release (PublishPackageVersion)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws codeartifact describe-domain --domain shared --domain-owner 123456789012
  aws codeartifact describe-repository --domain shared --repository team-payments-maven
  aws codeartifact list-repositories-in-domain --domain shared
  aws codeartifact get-repository-endpoint --domain shared --repository team-payments-maven --format maven
  aws codeartifact login --tool mvn --repository team-payments-maven --domain shared --domain-owner 123456789012

eval_cases.name: Cross-account domain sharing via RAM resource share
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — RAM resource share + consumer IAM
eval_cases.prompt: Share the existing CodeArtifact domain named shared (owner 123456789012) with consumer account 123456789012 in us-east-1. Use a RAM resource share named codeartifact-shared-domain. The consumer account's IAM role consumer-ci-build needs codeartifact:GetAuthorizationToken and codeartifact:ReadFromRepository on the shared domain's ARN (with owner account ID 123456789012 embedded). The consumer uses `aws codeartifact login --tool npm --domain shared --domain-owner 123456789012 --repository shared-npm`. Account: 123456789012 (owner).
eval_cases.expected_output:
REPOSITORY: shared (domain-level share)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Domain — shared (existing, owner 123456789012)
  [✓]      RAM resource share — codeartifact-shared-domain
  [✓]      Principal — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root
  [✓]      Resource — arn:aws:codeartifact:us-east-1:123456789012:domain/shared
  [✓]      Consumer IAM role — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/consumer-ci-build (GetAuthorizationToken, ReadFromRepository on owner domain ARN)
  [✓]      Consumer login — aws codeartifact login --tool npm --domain shared --domain-owner 123456789012 --repository shared-npm
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ram get-resource-shares --resource-share-arns <ram-arn>
  aws codeartifact get-domain-permissions-policy --domain shared
  aws codeartifact describe-domain --domain shared --domain-owner 123456789012
  aws codeartifact login --tool npm --domain shared --domain-owner 123456789012 --repository shared-npm

eval_cases.name: swift repository in a Region without the public swift external connection
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Region-limited Swift external connection, generic-format approach
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a CodeArtifact repository for Swift packages in ap-southeast-1. Domain: mobile-shared (existing, owner 123456789012). The public swift external connection is NOT available in ap-southeast-1 (list-external-connections does not list it). Provide the recommendation (use a generic-format repository and copy-package-versions from us-east-1 where Swift is supported). CI role: mobile-ci. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
REPOSITORY: mobile-shared-swift
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Domain — mobile-shared (existing, owner 123456789012)
  [✓]      Repository — mobile-shared-swift
  [✓]      Format — generic (Swift external connection not available in ap-southeast-1)
  [✓]      Region constraint — ap-southeast-1 does not list public swift external connection; verified via list-external-connections
  [✓]      Package ingestion — copy-package-versions from us-east-1 (where Swift is supported) into this repository
  [✓]      Domain owner IAM — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/devops-admin (codeartifact:* on domain)
  [✓]      Repository consume policy — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/mobile-ci (ReadFromRepository, GetAuthorizationToken)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws codeartifact describe-domain --domain mobile-shared --domain-owner 123456789012 --region ap-southeast-1
  aws codeartifact describe-repository --domain mobile-shared --repository mobile-shared-swift --region ap-southeast-1
  aws codeartifact list-external-connections --domain mobile-shared --region ap-southeast-1
  aws codeartifact list-external-connections --domain mobile-shared --region us-east-1
  aws codeartifact copy-package-versions --domain mobile-shared --repository mobile-shared-swift --source-repository mobile-shared-swift-us-east-1 --format swift --package <pkg> --versions <ver> --region ap-southeast-1
